§6Manufactory§f

§aThe ore processing workhorse.§f
The §bManufactory§f takes §b1 item input§f and produces §b1 item output§f. Default cycle is §b400 ticks§f at §b20 RF/t§f. It's NuclearCraft's primary ore processor, doubling or tripling your ore yields depending on the recipe.

Put ores in, get dusts out. Put ingots in, get dusts out. It's versatile and fast. The Manufactory also handles some specialized recipes beyond basic ore doubling, like producing certain dusts from ingots.

§ePS:§f Build extras. You'll be using the Manufactory constantly throughout your playthrough. It's one of the most-used machines in the mod, and having multiples speeds up your early game significantly.
